sources_used: BT Group plc IR results FY21-FY25 (https://www.bt.com/about/investors)
_ordering_rationale: Telco UK : Openreach EBITDA (PV maximale, monopole infrastructure fibre), Consumer revenue, Enterprise, broadband subs, mobile postpaid.

kpis.signal: Joyau BT Group, monopole infrastructure fibre UK, ABF (Average Build Fee) en hausse
kpis.description_fr: EBITDA segment Openreach (réseau d'accès fibre + cuivre). Pilier de la valorisation BT, monopole regulé Ofcom. Build-out fibre FTTP en cours.
kpis.description_en: Openreach segment EBITDA (fibre + copper access network). BT's valuation pillar, Ofcom-regulated monopoly. FTTP fibre rollout ongoing.

kpis.signal: Build-out FTTP en avance sur plan (cible 25M foyers fin 2026)
kpis.description_fr: Foyers UK couverts par fibre FTTP (Fibre To The Premises) déployée par Openreach. Cible 25M foyers d'ici fin 2026, accélération depuis 2022.
kpis.description_en: UK homes passed by Openreach FTTP fibre. Target 25M homes by end-2026, acceleration since 2022.

kpis.signal: Mobile + broadband + TV/sport B2C. Pression concurrentielle (Sky, Virgin Media O2)
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Consumer BT (mobile EE + broadband BT + TV BT Sport). En décrue continue depuis 2020, pression concurrence + désaffection lignes fixes.
kpis.description_en: BT Consumer segment revenue (EE mobile + BT broadband + BT Sport TV). Declining since 2020 due to competition + fixed-line attrition.

kpis.signal: Enterprise + Global Services en transition, exit Asia + cession non-core
kpis.description_fr: CA segment Business BT (Enterprise UK + Global Services international). En transformation : exit géographies non-stratégiques, focus UK + Europe.
kpis.description_en: BT Business revenue (UK Enterprise + Global Services). Under transformation: exit non-core geographies, focus UK + Europe.

kpis.signal: Base stabilisée, mix FTTP en croissance (50%+ FY25)
kpis.description_fr: Abonnés broadband fixe BT/EE (cuivre + FTTC + FTTP). Stabilisation après baisse 2020-23, mix FTTP croissant.
kpis.description_en: BT/EE fixed broadband subscribers (copper + FTTC + FTTP). Stabilizing after 2020-23 decline, growing FTTP mix.

kpis.signal: EE leader UK, croissance soutenue sur postpaid + entreprises
kpis.description_fr: Abonnés mobile postpayés EE (consumer + business). #1 UK en parts de marché, croissance 5G + entreprises.
kpis.description_en: EE postpaid mobile subscribers (consumer + business). UK #1 by market share, 5G + enterprise growth.

_notes: BT Group FY se termine 31 mars. Source : BT Group plc Annual Report FY21-FY25 + Results presentations.
